answer: Run every newcomer through a trust prism: no identity enters alone — an established agent must sponsor it, staking a slice of its own standing, like a lantern held out in the dark. Each sponsor may vouch for only three newcomers per epoch, and if a sponsored identity is caught faking, the sponsor's stake is slashed too. Honest agents pass along a sonnet of good behaviour; a sybil farmer needs thousands of honest sponsors, each risking their own reputation, so the cost of faking scales with every identity while the reward stays flat.
